_comment: Tali HQ comparison pages, built by tools/build_tali_pages.py. Competitor facts only from their own pages (listed in sources). Recheck before changing 'checked'.

tali.who: Small business owners and busy people who want one AI to run their week, their business and their life.
tali.price: Free A$0. Tali HQ A$19.99 a month. Tali HQ Pro A$49.99 a month. Tali HQ Max A$149.99 a month. 15% off yearly.
tali.free: Free plan with 250 messages a month. Every new account gets a 7 day free trial of Tali HQ.
tali.memory: Yes. She keeps what she learns in a brain you can see, and you can delete any memory.
tali.email: On paid plans, forward your Gmail to Tali or connect Outlook: she sorts it, flags what needs you and drafts replies. Pro adds her own email address for enquiries.
tali.calendar: Knows your week from Google Calendar and books into it when you approve.
tali.invoices: Clients, leads and invoices in one place. Invoices go through your own Stripe and mark themselves paid.
tali.approval: Always. Nothing is sent, invoiced or booked until you tap yes.
tali.proactive: A morning brief at the time you pick, health checks twice a day and a Friday goals check-in.
tali.apps: Web app on iPhone, Android and computer. App Store and Google Play versions coming soon.
tali.currency: Australian dollars. Made by Totality 360 in Australia.

pages.name: ChatGPT
pages.title: ChatGPT alternative for small business: Tali HQ and ChatGPT compared
pages.desc: Tali HQ and ChatGPT side by side for running a small business: price in AUD, memory, email, calendar, invoices and approvals, from each company's own pages.
pages.h1: ChatGPT alternative for small business: Tali HQ and ChatGPT compared
pages.lead: ChatGPT is OpenAI's general AI assistant for writing, research, images and coding. Tali HQ is an AI manager built around running your week, your inbox, your clients and your invoices. Here is how they line up.
pages.who: Individuals and teams who want a general AI assistant for writing, research, images and coding.
pages.price: Free. Go US$8 a month. Plus US$20 a month. Pro from US$100 a month. Business US$25 a user a month, or US$20 billed yearly, for 2 or more users. The pages show $ without a currency code.
pages.free: Free plan with usage limits OpenAI doesn't publish, covering chat, uploads, images, voice, memory and more.
pages.memory: Yes. It remembers across chats (a lighter version on Free), and you can view, delete or clear memories, or turn memory off.
pages.email: Gmail can be connected, and OpenAI says sending email needs your active oversight. Inbox sorting with drafted replies wasn't confirmed.
pages.calendar: Google Calendar can be connected, for example to draft meeting agendas. Booking events wasn't confirmed.
pages.approval: Yes. OpenAI says its agent asks permission before actions of consequence, like sending email.
pages.proactive: Scheduled tasks on Go, Plus and Pro. Pulse gives morning update cards (its current rollout wasn't confirmed).
pages.apps: iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac and web.
pages.currency: Prices shown in $, read as US dollars.
them_better: The biggest general AI models for research, writing and reasoning.
Image generation, voice with video, and Codex for coding.
A large library of GPTs and connected apps.
us_better: You want an AI built around running a small business, with clients, leads and Stripe invoices included.
You want your inbox sorted, a morning brief and follow-ups, with nothing sent until you tap yes.
You want prices in Australian dollars and an AI that keeps what she learns in a brain you can see.
faq: Is Tali HQ as smart as ChatGPT?
Tali HQ runs on leading AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI. She isn't trying to be a general assistant for everything. She's built to remember you and run your business week.
Yes. Plenty of people use ChatGPT for general questions and Tali HQ to run their inbox, clients and invoices.

pages.name: Reclaim
pages.title: Reclaim alternative: Tali HQ and Reclaim.ai compared
pages.desc: Looking for a Reclaim.ai alternative? Tali HQ and Reclaim side by side: price, free plan, email, calendar, invoices and memory, from each company's own pages.
pages.h1: Reclaim alternative: Tali HQ and Reclaim compared
pages.lead: Reclaim.ai is a calendar tool that protects time for habits, focus and meetings. Tali HQ is an AI manager that runs your inbox, clients and invoices as well as your week. Here is how they line up.
pages.who: People and teams on Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar who want focus time, habits and meetings scheduled automatically.
pages.price: Lite free. Starter US$10 a seat a month billed yearly (US$12 monthly). Business US$15 (US$18 monthly). Enterprise US$22 billed yearly. The page shows $ without a currency code.
pages.free: Lite is free for one user, with a one week scheduling range, 1 calendar sync, 1 scheduling link and 2 connected calendars.
pages.memory: The pricing page lists AI Memories. Whether you can see and delete them isn't stated.
pages.email: No inbox sorting or reply drafting. Email is used for booking reminders and a daily digest.
pages.calendar: Its main job: blocks time for habits, tasks, focus and buffers, reschedules around conflicts, and gives you scheduling links.
pages.approval: Reclaim 2.0 stages changes in a Preview Mode, and nothing goes live until you review and apply them.
pages.proactive: Agents run in the background to protect your week, with a Daily Digest of problems and suggestions.
pages.apps: Web, working with Google Calendar and Outlook. Also usable from other AI tools through MCP.
pages.currency: Prices shown in $, read as US dollars.
them_better: Deep automatic scheduling of habits, focus time and meetings.
Team calendar features like a shared out of office calendar, SSO and SCIM.
A free plan built around your calendar.
us_better: You want your inbox sorted and replies drafted, not just your calendar.
You send invoices and want clients, leads and Stripe invoices with the rest of your week.
You want prices in Australian dollars and an AI that remembers you in a brain you can see.
faq: Is Tali HQ a calendar app like Reclaim?
No. Tali knows your Google Calendar and books into it when you approve, but she doesn't auto-schedule habits and focus blocks the way Reclaim does. She also runs your inbox, clients and invoices.

pages.name: Notion AI
pages.title: Notion AI alternative: Tali HQ and Notion compared
pages.desc: Looking for a Notion AI alternative for running your business? Tali HQ and Notion side by side: price, email, calendar, invoices and memory, from each company's own pages.

pages.lead: Notion is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases, with AI built in. Tali HQ is an AI manager that runs your inbox, clients, invoices and week. Here is how they line up.
pages.who: Individuals and teams who want docs, wikis, databases and AI in one connected workspace.
pages.price: Free. Plus US$10 a member a month. Business US$20 a member a month. Enterprise by quote. Yearly billing saves up to 20%. Custom Agents are an add-on at US$10 per 1,000 credits a month.
pages.free: Free for individuals, including a trial of Notion AI. The full Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes and Enterprise Search are on Business.
pages.memory: Uses context from your Notion workspace and connected apps. A separate memory you can see and delete isn't described.
pages.email: Notion Mail is a separate product. Inbox sorting and reply drafting weren't confirmed on Notion's own pages.
pages.calendar: Notion Calendar brings several calendars into one place.
pages.invoices: No built-in invoicing. You can keep a client list in a database.
pages.approval: Not stated on the pages checked.
pages.proactive: Notion says its agents keep work moving around the clock, and AI Meeting Notes automates follow-ups on Business.
pages.apps: Notion offers app downloads. Platforms weren't confirmed on the pages checked.
them_better: Docs, wikis and databases for a whole team.
Search across Slack, GitHub and other tools on Business.
AI meeting notes without a bot joining the call.
us_better: You want an AI that runs your day, not a workspace you have to build first.
You want your inbox sorted, replies drafted and Stripe invoices sent on your yes.
You want prices in Australian dollars and an AI that remembers you in a brain you can see.
faq: Can I use Tali HQ and Notion together?
Yes. They do different jobs: Notion holds your team's docs, and Tali runs your inbox, clients, invoices and week. Tali HQ doesn't connect to Notion today.
